mockup.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exquisite high fidelity product-design presentation board for SÜKÛN's Berhetiyye mobile app gemstone theme, landscape composition 3:2. Image1 is the existing real screen and functional layout reference. Image2 is the approved jewel craft style. Image3 is the approved emerald bezel material. This is an evolution of the functional app, not a game inventory.
Show TWO main columns with generous spacing: LEFT a large tall mobile UI panel with the bottom of an impressive gold/amethyst dhikr wheel, counters "Hedef 507" and "Kalan 347", small "Çark" and "Arka plan" selectors, a row "−1" "Duraklat" "+1" "Bitir", a navigation row "Önceki" "Baştan" "Sonraki", then a 3x2 grid "Dinle" "Döngü" "Kayıt" / "Niyet" "Favori" "Nasıl?", and a refined expanded "Seyir tekrarları ve ara" panel with native-like selectors "Her isim" "Ebcedi kadar" and "Ara" "0,9 sn". All controls are visibly jewel objects with softly rounded silhouette, massive engraved gold bezels, real crystalline facets around a quiet dark stone center, clean readable ivory text aligned inside stones. No letters crossing bezels, no giant pointed spikes. Strong carved geometric metal details, premium substantial masculine craft. Assign EMERALD GREEN for play and plus, RUBY RED for stop and recording, SAPPHIRE BLUE for background and navigation/listen, AMETHYST PURPLE for wheel, intention/contemplation, DIAMOND/SMOKY CRYSTAL with white bright edges and dark centers for counters, reset, help. Actual stone texture, not colored flat rectangles.
RIGHT three flow-player component previews stacked vertically, each independently labeled above "MİNİ", "MİDİ", "MAX". MINI a slim long green crystal-and-gold player capsule with a fine progress line, "Yâ Berheşin", "160 / 507", an emerald pause jewel and a small diamond expand jewel. MIDI compact player with title, progress, 3 small useful stat insets and play/stop/expand gems. MAX larger full player with header "BERHETİYYE", title "Yâ Berheşin", sapphire and smoky-diamond small metric tiles "İlerleme 160 / 507", "Kalan 347", "Tempo 0,9 sn", jeweled volume control and emerald pause / ruby stop controls. Keep practical mobile density, 44px-like touch targets, no unnecessary huge borders.
Backdrop dark deep teal palace architecture, distant lantern gold, subtle amethyst/emerald haze, lower contrast than interfaces. Board title top "SÜKÛN • BERHETİYYE" and subtitle "Beş taş • Tek tasarım dili". Hyperrealistic 3D jewelry materials with modern legible UI typography, restrained highlights. Preserve all functional elements, no phone hardware, no browser/status bars, no watermark, no invented Arabic writing. This is a realistic implementation-oriented mockup; do not distort typography.
